business: India's leading omnichannel beauty and lifestyle platform combining commerce, content, community. Operates digital marketplace (10,000+ brands), 313 retail stores, B2B network (500k retailers). Generates revenue through product margins, B2B commissions, owned brands. Serves 55M+ customers.

segments.name: Fashion & Lifestyle
segments.comment: Part of total NR ₹10,022cr, expanding portfolio

revenue_mix: Geography: Tier 2/3 cities ~60% of beauty sales. Product: Beauty 85%, Fashion 15%. Customer: Primarily B2C (55M), with B2B through Superstore (500k retailers).
strategy: Expand brand partnerships (10,000+ brands, 200+ launches FY26)
Scale omnichannel: 313 stores, digital, B2B channels
Grow House of Nykaa owned brands (₹3,176cr GMV)
Enhance personalization through technology and data insights
outlook: Limited explicit forward guidance in opening pages. Implicit confidence in category expansion and omnichannel scalability shown by record 76 store openings FY2026. Market tailwinds from rising aspirations and digital-first discovery.
capex_plans: Retail expansion: 76 stores opened FY2026 (record). 15 Nykaa Luxe stores and dedicated Perfumery stores planned. Specific capex amounts not disclosed.
